title: Conditions of Use for the Named Benefits of a Wanderlane Traveller Club Tier
content:
**Conditions accompanying the benefit schedule of the Wanderlane Traveller Club.**

### Counting and the membership year

The named benefits a tier grants are counted per membership year running from the tier effective date, and an allowance not used inside that year does not carry into the next. Each named benefit is counted separately, by the uses of that benefit recorded against the membership within that membership year.

### When a benefit is granted at all

A benefit is granted only while the membership record stands at active. The membership record is the authority for this, and it must stand at active before the use of the benefit is recorded against that membership.

### Lounge passes

Lounge passes admit the member plus the tier's guest allowance on one visit, and a visit beyond the allowance is bought at the lounge's own counter price rather than granted here.

### Benefits taken at the moment of travel

Free checked bags, priority boarding and priority check-in are granted by the tier at the moment of travel and are never converted into points or money when they go unused.

### Waived change fees

A waived change fee is applied against the fee that would otherwise be charged, up to the tier's annual count, and the waiver is spent on the fee actually raised and not on the largest fee available.

### Benefits that depend on the property

Guaranteed late checkout and the room-upgrade queue position apply only where the property participates, and a property that does not participate gives rise to no compensation.

### Companion vouchers

A companion voucher is issued in the member's own name and may not be sold, transferred or exchanged for value.

## Points of judgement

An allowance is measured against the membership year that runs from the tier effective date, not against the calendar year, so a member whose tier took effect part way through a calendar year counts the allowance from that date.

Where a member has several change fees in prospect, a waiver is spent on the fee actually raised; it is not held back against a larger fee that has not been raised.

Where a party larger than the member plus the tier's guest allowance presents itself at a lounge, the guests beyond the allowance are bought in at the lounge's own counter price.
